Paper Name: Components sizing of photovoltaic stand-alone system based on loss of power supply probability
NOTES: PV-only SAPS with battery banks. No wind, hydrogen, FC, EL, or diesel. Daily load: 813 kWh (explicitly reported). LPSP target was 1% but actual is 0.812% (LCC method baseline). Annual maintenance cost: RM 247,774 (system total, not per-component). Battery charging efficiency: 80%. Battery SOC: 20-80%. Battery: 48 V, 10 kW. PV array: 5×5 (25 modules/array). Inverter: 4 × 18 kW Leonics, 90% efficiency. LCC method uses 21 PV arrays, 57 battery banks.
